Definition: Sion, the summit of Mount Hermon
BiblicalUsage: Sion is the summit of Mount Hermon, named once, in the border of the land east of Jordan. From Aroer by the river Arnon to Mount Sion, which is Hermon, the Lord marked out the territory He gave to Israel.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God names the mountains that mark His gifts. Sion is Hermon by another name, and I hold that the borders He draws are the borders that stand.
